note: from the game's item XML and strings (tools/make_consumables.py); ids are numbers in data/consumable_ids.json, append-only

items.name: Black Blood
items.desc: Witcher's blood injures vampires and necrophages when they wound him.

items.name: Enhanced Black Blood
items.desc: Witcher's blood injures and knocks back vampires and necrophages when they wound him.

items.name: Superior Black Blood
items.desc: Vampires and necrophages start Bleeding when near the witcher. In addition, the witcher's blood injures and knocks them back when they wound him.

items.name: Blizzard
items.desc: When you are in danger, time slows for a short period.

items.name: Enhanced Blizzard
items.desc: When you are in danger, time slows for a short period. Extended duration.

items.name: Superior Blizzard
items.desc: When you are in danger, time slows for a short period. If 3 Adrenaline Points are available, during this period actions don't deplete Stamina.

items.name: Cat
items.desc: Grants sight in total darkness. Increases critical hit chance.

items.name: Enhanced Cat
items.desc: Grants sight in total darkness and immunity to hypnosis. Increases critical hit chance. Extended duration.

items.name: Superior Cat
items.desc: Grants sight in total darkness and immunity to hypnosis. Increases critical hit chance. Extended duration.

items.name: Superior Full Moon
items.desc: Increases maximum Vitality. Extended duration. Heals Vitality by an amount equal to current Toxicity.

items.name: Golden Oriole
items.desc: Grants immunity to poisons, neutralizes the effects of poisons already in bloodstream.

items.name: Enhanced Golden Oriole
items.desc: Grants immunity to poisons, neutralizes the effects of poisons already in bloodstream. Extended duration.

items.name: Superior Golden Oriole
items.desc: Extended duration. Poisons now heal instead of doing damage.

items.name: Killer Whale
items.desc: Increases breath supply while underwater by 50% and improves vision while diving.

items.name: Maribor Forest
items.desc: Accelerates the generation of Adrenaline Points.

items.name: Enhanced Maribor Forest
items.desc: Accelerates the generation of Adrenaline Points. Extended duration.

items.name: Superior Maribor Forest
items.desc: Accelerates the generation of Adrenaline Points. Extended duration. Grants 1 Adrenaline Point upon consumption.

items.name: Superior Petri's Philter
items.desc: Increases Sign intensity. Extended duration. Signs always apply their special effects.

items.name: Swallow
items.desc: Accelerates Vitality regeneration. Vitality regeneration pauses for 2 seconds upon receiving damage.

items.name: Enhanced Swallow
items.desc: Accelerates Vitality regeneration. Vitality regeneration pauses for 2 seconds upon receiving damage.

items.name: Superior Swallow
items.desc: Accelerates Vitality regeneration. Taking damage does not interrupt regeneration.

items.name: Superior Tawny Owl
items.desc: Accelerates Stamina regeneration. Extended duration. Never expires at night.

items.name: Superior Thunderbolt
items.desc: Extended duration. Grants 100% critical hit chance during storms.

items.name: White Honey
items.desc: Clears Toxicity and cancels all active potion effects.

items.name: Enhanced White Honey
items.desc: Clears Toxicity and cancels all active potion effects.

items.name: Superior White Honey
items.desc: Clears Toxicity and cancels all active potion effects.

items.name: Arachas decoction
items.desc: Reduces damage received based on armor and inventory weight: less weight carried and lighter armor means less damage is taken.

items.name: Cockatrice decoction
items.desc: All alchemy creations can be used one additional time.

items.name: Archgriffin decoction
items.desc: If any Stamina is available, strong attacks consume all of it and reduce the struck foe's Vitality by 5% after their normal damage is calculated.

items.name: Water hag decoction
items.desc: Damage dealt is increased when Vitality is at its maximum.

items.name: Nightwraith decoction
items.desc: Geralt's maximum Vitality is increased with each foe killed. This increase lasts until he meditates or fast travels.

items.name: Ekimmara decoction
items.desc: Damage dealt to foes regenerates Vitality.

items.name: Chort decoction
items.desc: Provides complete resistance to the Stagger effect and reduces the Knock-down effect to Stagger.

items.name: Foglet decoction
items.desc: Increases Sign Intensity during cloudy weather.

items.name: Wyvern decoction
items.desc: Each blow landed increases Attack Power until either the fight ends or damage (other than that from Toxicity) is taken.

items.name: Doppler decoction
items.desc: Increases critical hit damage when attacking from behind.

items.name: Troll decoction
items.desc: Regenerates Vitality during and outside of combat.

items.name: Noonwraith decoction
items.desc: Significantly limits the duration of Knockdown, Hypnosis, Stun and Blindness.

items.name: Succubus decoction
items.desc: Attack Power grows over the course of a fight until reaching a maximum threshold.

items.name: Alghoul decoction
items.desc: Adrenaline Points are generated more quickly than normal until the first successful enemy attack.

items.name: Fiend decoction
items.desc: Increases the amount of weight the witcher can carry without being overburdened.

items.name: Forktail decoction
items.desc: Combining various attacks (strong strikes, fast strikes, Signs) grants a bonus that increases Attack Power for the next attack mounted or Sign Intensity for the next Sign cast.

items.name: Grave hag decoction
items.desc: Each foe slain accelerates Vitality regeneration for the duration of the battle.

items.name: Wraith decoction
items.desc: Whenever a single hit drains more than a third of Vitality, a Quen shield is activated which protects against the next attack.

items.name: Earth elemental decoction
items.desc: Increases the witcher's resistance to Vitality-depleting critical effects applied during combat. The resistance level rises the longer the critical effect is applied.

items.name: Ekhidna decoction
items.desc: Performing actions that consume Stamina regenerates Vitality.

items.name: Ancient leshen decoction
items.desc: Each Sign cast increases Stamina regeneration for the remainder of the fight.

items.name: Basilisk decoction
items.desc: Applies a buff increasing the intensity of a randomly selected Sign at dusk and dawn. Lasts longer than other mutagen decoctions.

items.name: Werewolf decoction
items.desc: Significantly increases Stamina regeneration during a clear, moonlit night.

items.name: Nekker warrior decoction
items.desc: Mounts never panic. 50% increase to mounted combat damage.

items.name: Leshen decoction
items.desc: A portion of the damage dealt by enemies is reflected back on the attacker.

items.name: Griffin decoction
items.desc: Taking damage raises damage resistance (up to an upper limit) for the remainder of the fight.

items.name: Reliever's decoction
items.desc: Increases damage against specters, and decreases damage from specters. Attacking a specter prevents it from using its abilities and turning immaterial.

items.name: White Raffard's Decoction
items.desc: Immediately restores a portion of Vitality.

items.name: Enhanced White Raffard's Decoction
items.desc: Immediately restores a large portion of Vitality.

items.name: Superior White Raffard's Decoction
items.desc: Restores Vitality immediately and fully. Grants immunity to damage for a short duration.

items.name: Dancing Star
items.desc: Produces a fiery explosion that can cause nearby opponents to start burning. Destroys monster nests.

items.name: Enhanced Dancing Star
items.desc: Produces a fiery explosion that can cause nearby opponents to start burning. Enhanced effect. Destroys monster nests.

items.name: Superior Dancing Star
items.desc: Produces a fiery explosion that ignites the surrounding area. Enhanced and extended effect. Destroys monster nests.

items.name: Devil's Puffball
items.desc: Releases a cloud of poison when detonated.

items.name: Enhanced Devil's Puffball
items.desc: Releases a cloud of poison when detonated. Enhanced effect.

items.name: Superior Devil's Puffball
items.desc: Releases a cloud of poison when detonated. Enhanced and extended effect.

items.name: Dragon's Dream
items.desc: Releases a cloud of gas that explodes when ignited.

items.name: Enhanced Dragon's Dream
items.desc: Releases a cloud of gas that explodes when ignited. Enhanced effect and chance to apply Burning.

items.name: Superior Dragon's Dream
items.desc: Releases a cloud of gas that explodes when ignited. Enhanced effect and chance to apply Burning. Foes it kills explode, wounding others nearby.

items.name: Dimeritium bomb
items.desc: Releases a cloud of dimeritium slivers that block magic and monsters' magic abilities.

items.name: Enhanced Dimeritium bomb
items.desc: Releases a cloud of dimeritium slivers that block magic and monsters' magic abilities.

items.name: Superior Dimeritium bomb
items.desc: Releases a cloud of dimeritium slivers that block magic and monsters' magic abilities. The blockade survives for a short time after the cloud dissipates.

items.name: Grapeshot
items.desc: Inflicts shrapnel damage to foes within its explosion radius. Deals a small amount of fire damage. Destroys monster nests.

items.name: Enhanced Grapeshot
items.desc: Inflicts shrapnel damage to foes within its explosion radius. Deals fire damage. Enhanced effect. Destroys monster nests.

items.name: Superior Grapeshot
items.desc: Inflicts shrapnel damage to foes within its explosion radius. Deals fire damage. Enhanced effect. Damage ignores enemy armor. Destroys monster nests.

items.name: Samum
items.desc: Blinds opponents within its explosion radius. Destroys monster nests.

items.name: Enhanced Samum
items.desc: Blinds opponents within its explosion radius. Extended duration. Destroys monster nests.

items.name: Superior Samum
items.desc: Blinds opponents within its explosion radius. Extended duration. The first hit landed on a blinded opponent is always critical. Destroys monster nests.

items.name: Moon Dust
items.desc: Contains silver splinters that temporarily prevent monsters from transforming and regenerating.

items.name: Enhanced Moon Dust
items.desc: Contains silver splinters that temporarily prevent monsters from transforming and regenerating. Extended duration.

items.name: Superior Moon Dust
items.desc: Contains silver splinters that permanently prevent monsters from transforming and regenerating.

items.name: Northern Wind
items.desc: Freezes foes. Blows landed on frozen foes deal additional damage.

items.name: Enhanced Northern Wind
items.desc: Freezes foes. Blows landed on frozen foes deal additional damage. Extended duration.

items.name: Superior Northern Wind
items.desc: Freezes foes. Blows landed on frozen foes deal additional damage. Extended duration. Chance of instant kill.
